mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the irises was most worthwhile because the completed ray diagram brought the cornea, pupil, lens and retina together into one light path.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the lenses was straightforward, but it repeated the slot-filling pattern established with the corneas.

surprise.text: The visual-pathway result clarified that a pattern leaves the eye as nerve signals, rather than as a beam of light.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the named slots and pictures made the construction sequence understandable.

continue.text: I would continue into another chapter: connecting the finished eyes to the body made me curious about how another sense might fit into the model.
